title: Adventurous Smoky Korean Black Pudding Namul
description: A sweet and savory Korean dish featuring black pudding, grilled to perfection and mixed with various namul ingredients, this adventurous recipe is FODMAP-friendly and offers a unique taste experience.

ingredients.name: grilled carrots
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch thick rounds

instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together sesame oil, soy sauce, and garlic-infused oil to make the namul sauce.
Brush the black pudding slices with the namul sauce and grill for 3-4 minutes per side, or until crispy and slightly charred.
Grill the zucchini and carrots for 2-3 minutes per side, or until tender and lightly charred.
In a large bowl, combine the grilled black pudding, zucchini, and carrots.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds, chopped green onions, salt, and black pepper over the top of the namul mixture.
Toss the namul mixture gently to combine, being careful not to break the grilled ingredients.
Serve the Adventurous Smoky Korean Black Pudding Namul hot, garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
